title: Pokemon TCG Pocket Cards V5 Core Schema

id.description: Set prefix and padded card number (e.g., "a1-001").

name.description: The printed name of the card.

pack.description: The specific pack the card drops from, or "Shared".

subtype.description: Energy type for Pokémon. Item classification for Trainers.

stage.description: Basic, Stage 1, or Stage 2. Null for Trainers.

ex.description: True if the card is an "ex" rulebox Pokémon.

mega.description: True if the card is a Mega Evolution.

health.description: The maximum hit points. Null for Trainers.

points.description: Points awarded to the opponent when knocked out. Null for Trainers.

deckBuilderNr.description: The internal integer used by the game client for deck rendering.

image.description: URL to the WEBP version of the card image.
